findings.text: Routine fcntl_setlk64 handles range lock requests for open files using a descriptor number plus open file plus command plus range descriptor and reports failure with a negative status while covering private open file description forms and blocking forms.

Routine filename_lookup resolves a prepared name relative to a directory descriptor with lookup flags into a result path with optional alternate root and issues an audit record on success while returning operation status.

Routines file_open_root and do_file_open_root open a name relative to an anchored path using supplied flags and mode translated into internal open state before delegating to the low level open path with retry handling.
Routines nsfs_get_root and pidfs_get_root supply the stable root path of special filesystems and hold an extra reference on the returned path for caller use.
Routine send_sigurg notifies the owner of urgent condition on a file and reports whether an owner with a valid identity existed for notification.
Routine has_locked_children scans direct child mounts of a mount for a locked child whose mount point lies under a given dentry and reports presence with a boolean result.

Open file description lock requests require a zero process identifier in the range descriptor and set a private lock flag with ownership overridden to the open file while rewriting the command to the corresponding 64 bit form and marking blocking forms as sleep capable.

Native and compat range descriptors share five logical members for type plus whence plus start plus length plus process identifier that are copied as a group between user and kernel forms with output forms zero filled before copy and compile time size checks on start and length for 64 bit compat output.
Compat range fixup rejects a start beyond the compat offset maximum with an overflow status and clamps an oversize length to that maximum while leaving other values unchanged.

File handle encoding bounds caller supplied byte size by a maximum and converts between bytes and words by a factor of four and signals overflow when encoded size exceeds caller buffer or when filesystem reports invalid or no space while copying only the fixed header on overflow.

Handle decode rejects zero or oversize byte counts and negative or disallowed user flag bits and derives connectable plus directory only decode modes from user type bits while stripping user flag bits before filesystem decode.

Handle decode allows global read search capability to bypass further checks and otherwise requires directory only open plus either filesystem admin capability or an unobstructed subtree with bind mount rights plus read search capability in current namespace while enforcing directory only decode and ancestor mapping plus optional subtree confinement during acceptance.

Range lock path holds the files spin lock across descriptor lookup after a successful lock to order against close path updates of POSIX lock state where a read copy update read lock alone is documented as insufficient.

Urgent notification holds the owner read lock with interrupts saved while sampling identity plus type and uses read copy update protection while resolving the single task or iterating group tasks before releasing the owner lock.

Subtree validation holds a mount reader guard while testing mounted state plus admin rights plus absence of locked children and mount capability sampling holds a read copy update guard across namespace access while a dedicated spin lock exists for async notification state.

Range descriptor layout in native and compat forms carries type plus whence plus start plus length plus process identifier with 64 bit compat forms widening start and length while preserving the same logical member set.

File handle layout carries a byte count plus a type value plus a variable tail of identifier bytes sized dynamically from caller supplied count with in memory size computed from fixed header plus tail bytes.
Owner state carries a lock plus identity type plus identity reference and decode context carries a root path plus check flags plus filesystem decode flags used across acceptance and raw decode.

Compat fcntl dispatch validates descriptor presence plus path mode command allowance plus security approval then routes get versus set and 32 versus 64 bit forms through compat copy plus native operation plus fixup and output copy for queries while other commands fall through to generic handling.
Name lookup proceeds from read copy update attempt to plain attempt on retry signal to revalidating attempt on stale signal and completes with audit notification when resolution succeeds.

Root relative open rejects symlink roots for open intent then tries read copy update open followed by plain open on retry signal followed by revalidating open on stale signal before returning the resulting file or status.

Name to handle translation rejects unknown flag bits and conflicting connectable combinations then maps fid versus connectable request to internal encode flags and resolves follow versus nofollow lookup before lookup plus encode plus release.

Handle to path resolution copies and validates the user header then resolves the mount anchor and permission hook or default check then copies the full handle and derives decode flags before raw decode and anchor release.

Handle encoding checks export support plus disconnected state for connectable requests plus caller size bounds then allocates and encodes and handles overflow followed by mount identity copy and handle copy with fault status overriding success.

Compat fcntl entries expose 64 bit and legacy forms where the legacy form rejects 64 bit and open file description commands as invalid while the 64 bit form accepts the full set and both delegate to a common compat handler.
Name to handle entry accepts directory descriptor plus name plus user handle plus mount identity pointer plus flags and performs lookup with flag derived modes before encoding.

Open by handle entries accept mount descriptor plus user handle plus flags through a common helper that resolves handle to path then opens and installs the descriptor with large file mode forced on the native form.

Close versus lock race after successful non unlock private flag free lock handling revalidates the descriptor under spin lock and removes POSIX locks for the file and files table while returning bad descriptor status on mismatch.

User copy faults during handle header plus tail and compat range transfer abort the operation with fault status and mount identity copy fault overrides prior encode success without leaking allocated state.

Decode acceptance walks from decoded entry toward the anchor root checking identifier mapping on each ancestor and rejects unmapped paths or subtree escapes when confinement is requested while allowing unrestricted success for legacy zero flag callers or absent roots.
Allocation failure for lock state or handle buffers returns no lock or no memory status promptly without side effects on existing locks or paths.
Command translation maps 64 bit get plus set plus blocking set to their native equivalents and leaves all other command values unchanged for downstream handling.

Poll band table holds six entries where first combines EPOLLIN with EPOLLRDNORM and second combines EPOLLOUT with EPOLLWRNORM with EPOLLWRBAND and third combines EPOLLIN with EPOLLRDNORM with EPOLLMSG and fourth is EPOLLERR and fifth combines EPOLLPRI with EPOLLRDBAND and sixth combines EPOLLHUP with EPOLLERR.

Handle type user flags mark connectable plus directory properties with a mask defining valid user bits that are verified on input and stripped before filesystem decode while connectable encoding also records directory state for later verification.

Name to handle flags accept symlink follow plus empty path plus fid plus unique mount identity plus connectable while anchor resolution accepts non negative descriptors plus current directory plus pidfs root plus nsfs root and rejects other negative values.
